data.one_liner: Dart wrapper for the ReactJS library to build interactive web interfaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides bindings for ReactJS, allowing developers to create React components, manage state and lifecycle methods, and render elements using Dart for web applications.
use_when: You are building web applications in Dart and prefer React's component model over Flutter Web
You need to integrate with existing ReactJS libraries or projects
avoid_when: You are building standard Flutter mobile or desktop applications
You want to use modern Flutter widget trees and Material components
strengths: Includes unit testing utilities wrapping React TestUtils
weaknesses: Requires manual HTML setup and JavaScript file management
Deprecated APIs in older versions require migration
data.setup_notes: Requires adding JavaScript files for React and ReactDOM to your HTML file, along with the generated Dart JS output script.
